question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

Your sister is ________ advantage of my situation.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"taking"** means to make use of or exploit a situation or opportunity. (लाभ उठाना)

 
 
• **Example:** She is **taking** advantage of the sale to buy new clothes.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.&l
